meta.method: Chance of leaving: a walk-forward model of where each player is next season, trained on every earlier season's box scores (from 2014), recent seasons weighted more. Moves are inferred, not the official transfer portal: the same ESPN athlete on another team's box score next season is an inferred transfer; no box-score line next season covers graduation, the pros, a lower division, injury or not playing. The portal's public lists carry 247Sports ratings we may not republish. No class history exists in the data (only this season's rosters carry a class), so experience is the number of earlier seasons with a box-score line; no NIL, coaching or eligibility data. Football box scores never list offensive linemen, so they have no estimate. Targets rank likely transfers by their chance of joining the team: availability x a model of which teams transfers join (team and conference strength, the player's production x the team's strength, the team's expected departures); shown where that model beat availability alone.

leave.note: positions inferred from the box score in every season (fixed after the first run, which used roster positions only the current season has: -0.0435 [-0.0488, -0.0379])

targets.why: the destination model did not beat availability alone in the pre-registered run; the re-run after the position fix did (0.47% v 0.24% at 10, not at 25), which is post hoc: not shown

arrivals.basis: inferred transfers in per team, 2024-25 to 2025-26
